description: We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to make a significant impact on both staff development and patient safety.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in coordinating staff education and training programs, ensuring our team is equipped with the latest knowledge and skills. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, developing and implementing robust strategies to maintain a safe and healthy environment for residents and staff alike.This role is perfect for an experienced Registered Nurse passionate about fostering a culture of continuous learning and upholding the highest standards of infection control. Join a supportive team committed to delivering exceptional care and professional growth.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or education within a healthcare setting
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection prevention and control
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care, staff education, and infection control
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills

description: Join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL, as an Experienced Marketing Director. This is an exciting opportunity to lead marketing efforts for a recently purchased facility, bringing fresh energy and strategic vision to our team. We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented professional to drive census growth and enhance our community presence.In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies, building strong relationships with referral sources, and representing the facility with professionalism. The ideal candidate will be a proactive individual with a strong work ethic, capable of navigating a competitive market and achieving ambitious goals. Please note that occasional weekend work will be required to support community events and outreach initiatives.We are committed to attracting top talent and offer competitive compensation for the right individual who can demonstrate exceptional leadership and a proven track record in healthcare marketing. This is a chance to make a significant impact and grow with a forward-thinking organization.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or senior living environment.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective marketing strategies.
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills.
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed for outreach and events.
A proactive, results-driven approach to marketing and business development.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance for the right candidate.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a fantastic opportunity to provide essential therapy services on a flexible schedule, making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

This position comes with a highly competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, reflecting the critical nature of the role. Additionally, a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus is available for qualified candidates. If you are passionate about helping patients regain their communication and swallowing abilities and thrive in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49 per hour, with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
An exciting opportunity awaits dedicated rehabilitation professionals in Ocala, FL. We are seeking talented Occupational Therapists (OT), Physical Therapists (PT), Speech Therapists (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA), and Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center. Both full-time and part-time positions are available, offering flexibility to suit your lifestyle.

In this vital role, you will contribute to enhancing the quality of life for residents through comprehensive therapy services. You will work within a supportive environment, utilizing your expertise to develop and implement individualized treatment plans. This is a chance to make a significant impact while enjoying competitive compensation.

Join a team committed to excellence in patient care and professional growth. We are looking for passionate individuals ready to contribute their skills to a dynamic rehabilitation setting.
requirements: Current state licensure or certification as an OT, PT, ST, COTA, or PTA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility preferred
Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rates are offered, ranging from $28.00 to $46.00 per hour, with compensation based on your specific role and experience.
